name: Distance reset
description: Look at a relaxed point at least 6 meters away. Let your eyes rest without squinting.

name: Eyes at rest
description: Close your eyes gently and relax your face. Breathe normally.

name: Soft side-to-side gaze
description: Keep your head still and look slowly left, then right, within a comfortable range.

name: Near and far focus
description: Alternate your focus between a nearby object and something across the room.

name: Mindful blinking
description: Blink slowly and fully. Relax the muscles around your eyes between blinks.

name: Gentle neck turns
description: Sit tall. Slowly turn your head left and right, stopping before discomfort. Avoid full neck circles.

name: Side neck release
description: Gently tilt one ear toward the same-side shoulder. Keep both shoulders relaxed and switch sides.

name: Chin tuck
description: Look straight ahead. Gently glide your chin backward without bending your head down.

name: Small nods
description: Make a few small, slow nods within your comfortable range. Keep your jaw relaxed.

name: Shoulder rolls
description: Lift your shoulders gently, roll them back and let them drop. Keep the movement easy.

name: Across-body shoulder stretch
description: Bring one arm across your chest and support it lightly with the other. Repeat on the other side.

name: Reach overhead
description: Raise your arms as far as comfortable and reach upward gently. Lower them slowly.

name: Shoulder blade squeeze
description: Relax your shoulders downward. Gently draw your shoulder blades together, then release.

name: Open your chest
description: Place your hands on your hips and gently move your elbows back. Keep breathing easily.

name: Stand tall
description: Stand up if comfortable. Lengthen your spine and reach upward gently without arching hard.

name: Gentle torso turns
description: Sit or stand tall and slowly turn your upper body a little to each side. Avoid forcing the turn.

name: Standing back release
description: Stand with hands on your hips. Gently open the front of your body and return to neutral.

name: Seated side reach
description: Reach one arm upward and lean a little to the opposite side. Return to center and switch.

name: Posture reset
description: Place your feet comfortably, lengthen your spine and soften your shoulders. Take five easy breaths.

name: One-minute walk
description: Step away from the screen and walk at an easy pace. Choose a clear, comfortable route.

name: Comfortable mini squats
description: If suitable for you, bend your knees a little and stand again. Use stable support if needed.

name: Supported calf raises
description: Hold stable support, rise gently onto your toes and lower slowly. Keep the motion comfortable.

name: Seated leg extension
description: From a stable chair, slowly straighten one leg within a comfortable range. Lower and switch sides.

name: Ankle circles
description: While seated, lift one foot slightly and make small ankle circles. Switch direction and feet.

name: Easy march
description: March gently in place, standing or seated. Use a pace and range that feel comfortable.
